observations.trace: Consider a small recipe containing one composite pommel attached at weapon.root, with a lathed base profile [[0,0.01],[0.02,0.01]], one named socket at [0,0,0], and one Authored ornament of positive scale with positions [0,0,0] and empty indices. The checked profile has increasing axial coordinates and nonnegative, nonzero radii. Graph validation requires positions nonempty and divisible by3, indices divisible by3 and all indices in range, but does not require any index. Composite construction builds the lathed base, then ornament_solids iterates no triangles and returns an empty Solid as a PartSource. PhysicalProperties integrates every part; the ornament mass and first moment remain0, and its part center of mass computes 0 times infinity, producing NaN. The base may still provide positive total mass.
observations.remaining: Symbolic source reasoning only; no recipe, constructor, geometry, deserializer, model, physical calculation or test ran. Earlier Adler335 explicitly recorded this as a potential empty/open ornament needing the actual producer; this95e trace adds the producer without changing the historical count. Actual authored/editor reachability, nonempty degenerate or open meshes, consumers and global aliases remain open. Related to the grip nonempty/finite-output family but a distinct admission and producer.

observations.contract: Target frame reference versus local node references
observations.trace: Attachment.to is stored as String; the local AttachmentAnchor enum chooses a different child-side anchor. Placement formats and reparses frame names for its maps, inward direction and parent lookup. The preceding weapon-frame trace shows a global grip alias whose point and owner pose disagree. NodeBinding::Between, GuardMember paths and ornament socket names identify local nodes/sockets and have their own contexts; they are not automatically the same identity as global frames.
observations.remaining: Original delegated SEGOVB frame-text finding remains separate from Adler frame-owner finding pending exact alias review; the symbolic alias example demonstrates a specific consequence, not arbitrary custom-frame inward-direction policy. No parser, placement or model ran.

observations.contract: Quantities, blade clearance and graph admission
observations.trace: Metres, Ratio, Degrees and Radians accept finite f64 and canonicalize signed zero; their local shape owners separately enforce positivity or proportions. BladeProfile requires fuller iff recessed and validates groove dimensions before bounded clearance recursively checks same-face overlap and opposing walls. Guard binding order checks graph cycles, graph validation checks node presence and restricts Between t to0..1.
observations.remaining: Raw private numerical-kernel values are not all automatically bespoke-type defects, and valid zero/signed or absent modes must remain distinct. Continuous geometry proof, external editor admission and cross-lens owner inventory remain open. No sampler, validator, graph or geometry executed.
